participation.context: Wrote the sentence where the rehearsal had been, and did not spend the three words.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: his wait became a sentence, and not yet a speech

story.body: The listening king became a sentence on the tables. It did not become the speech.

relations.note: his wait became a sentence, and not yet a speech

title: Wrote that a listening king frights more than a shouting one

participation.context: Left the Plutarch flat, and did not open a sentence out of it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the sheets are unbound, and the chronicle is still his

story.body: The Plutarch lay unbound under a board. Daniel's third book was left for tomorrow. The Holinshed was still out. You copied no sentence.

relations.note: the sheets are unbound, and the chronicle is still his

title: Left the Plutarch on the shelf
